name: text-scale-blur-zoom
title: Scale Blur Zoom In
description: Cả dòng chữ thu nhỏ từ 1.4 lần về đúng cỡ và lấy nét từ vùng nhoè 12 px như ống kính lấy nét.

moworks.author: takayu

options.box: [x, y] start size of the AF brackets over the text box ([1.15, 1.3])

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-scale-blur-zoom, written here): Whole text: scale 1.4 → 1 (about its centre), blur 12 → 0 px, opacity 0 → 1, 0.7 s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) (demo 0.4–1.1 s). Demo dressing: viewfinder corner marks on the frame and AF corner brackets that shrink from 1.15× / 1.3× the text box to 1× and turn green on lock. Loop exit: fade 2.3–2.6 s; loop 2.8 s. Params: scale đầu (1.4) · blur (12 px) · duration (0.7 s) · ease (cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)).
moworks.titleVi: Chữ thu nhỏ, lấy nét như ống kính
